scope: CPU-only timestamp envelope decoder and observable regression; no visual or GPU execution acceptance
verdict: accepted source; final changed-source check results must be retained by producer
reasoning: Frame interval is min validated start to max validated end across allocated pairs, so overlapping and out-of-encoding-order groups remain enclosed without summing overlap.
Even count and aligned in-bounds pass indices prevent malformed count/index access and avoid index+1 overflow. Every pair is validated even when unlabelled.
The wider-than-half-u64 envelope refuses ambiguous between-pair wrap; this is a conservative counter-domain restriction, not an adapter-specific modulus or measured duration claim.
Per-pass labels and raw spans are unchanged. Timestamp writes, GPU submission/resolve, query lifetime and bounded pool ownership are unchanged.
New test exercises overlap/extrema, exact interval, pass containment, odd/out-of-range/max indices, reversed unlabelled pair, odd count and ordered pairs across wrap.
limitations: No new GPU run or rendered-pixel review by reviewer.
No inference that all frame work is instrumented; public docs explicitly exclude uninstrumented work and presentation.
Motion is a separate render pass and requires its own instrumentation or explicit scope exclusion in future composition.
